newsitem.title: CHINA: China Jan-Nov aluminium imports up 6.3 pct.
newsitem.headline: China Jan-Nov aluminium imports up 6.3 pct.

text.p: China's imports of unwrought aluminium and aluminium materials reached 569,018 tonnes in the first 11 months of 1996, up by 6.3 percent compared with the year-ago period, customs figures showed on Monday.
Imports of unwrought aluminium and aluminium materials in November alone reached 39,220 tonnes.
China's imports of unwrought aluminium including alloys dropped 2.1 percent to 328,008 tonnes in the first 11 months compared with the year-ago period.
Imports of unwrought aluminium including alloys were 20,143 tonnes in November alone.
Imports of alumina were 990,000 tonnes in the first 11 months, down 1.0 percent from the same period last year.
Imports of alumina in November alone were 120,000 tonnes.
China's exports of unwrought aluminium and aluminium materials fell 39.3 percent to 141,204 tonnes in the first 11 months of the year compared with the year-ago period.
Exports of unwrought aluminium and aluminium materials alloys were 19,781 tonnes in November alone.
Exports of unwrought aluminium including alloys fell 49.2 percent to 89,095 tonnes in the first 11 months compared with the year-ago period.
Exports in November alone were 13,345 tonnes.
Exports of alumina were 10,000 tonnes in the first 11 months, down 43.9 percent from the same period last year.
There were no exports of alumina in November.
